# ESG Hub

> Open-access encyclopedia of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) knowledge by Ascent Partners Foundation — 350+ articles, curated resources, a public REST API, and an MCP server. English, Chinese, and Hindi.

Live site: https://esg-hub.ascent.partners
Remote MCP: https://esg-hub.ascent.partners/api/mcp
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@simonmak-ascent/esg-hub-mcp
MCP Registry: io.github.simonmak-ascent/esg-hub
Repository: https://github.com/simonmak-ascent/esg-hub

## Topics
ESG reporting (IFRS S1/S2, GRI, SASB, TNFD), carbon accounting, climate risk, sustainability strategy, industries, glossary, and frameworks.

## Author
Ascent Partners Foundation / Simon Mak — https://simonmak.com
